name: QUT free airport reception
summary: A free 24-hour airport pick-up and transfer to your accommodation for new QUT international students arriving in Brisbane.
who: Newly commencing international students new to Brisbane, study abroad and exchange students, and QUT College students.
how: Accept your offer, get your CoE and visa, and book accommodation first, then book online.
catches: Book at least three working days before you arrive.
Extra people and luggage cost extra, paid to Bel-Air Limos.

evidence.quote: a free 24-hour airport reception and transfer service for new international students.
Airport reception bookings must be made at least three working days before your planned arrival date into Brisbane.
